rows.he: זֵֽכֶר תְּחִלַּת כָּל מַעַשׂ. אֲשֶׁר בְּכָל שָׁנָה נַעַשׂ. תּוֹחַלְתָּם לְמָאָס. יוֹצֵר בַּל יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: On the day of memory of the beginning of all action, let the Creator not remember those of the deeds of the whole year that are in conflict with Israel’s hopes.

rows.he: תּוֹכַחַת מַעַשׂ. אִם יָצְאָה בְּכַעַס. תּוֹמֵךְ לְמַעֲנוֹ יַעַשׂ. וִיצוּרִים יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: If reproof for those deeds has gone forth in anger, may He grant help for His own sake and remember the creatures.

rows.he: זֵֽכֶר שֶׁמִּבְּרֵאשִׁית. תְּבוּאַת רֵאשִׁית. שֹֽׁרֶשׁ בִּכּוּר רֵאשִׁית. יֵרָא וְיִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: May He look and recall the memory of the people He first appointed, the first harvest, the root of the first fruit.

rows.he: שֶֽׁצֶף חֲרִישִׁית. אִם חָר לְהָשִׁית. שׁוּבָה אֲשֶׁר הֵשִׁית. לַשּׁוֹבָבִים יִזְכֹּר:
rows.en: When in His anger He determines to send severe punishment, may He remember the atonement which He has ordained for the faithless.

rows.he: זֵֽכֶר רֹאשׁ עֲפָרוֹת. וְתוֹלָדוֹת סְפוּרוֹת. רְשׁוּם סְפוּרוֹת. לְמִסְפַּר חוֹל יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: He remembers the first man who was formed from dust, the countless generations and the inscribed (good deeds) on behalf of the people that is like the sand in number.

rows.he: רֶֽבַע מִסְפָּרוֹת. מְחַנְנֵי לְכַפָּרֹת. רֶֽגֶשׁ שׁוֹפָרֹת. לְשַׁפְּרֵם יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: He remembers those counted in four camps who implore expiation and sound the Shofar in order to purify themselves.

rows.he: זֵֽכֶר קְרִיאַת סֵפֶר. אֲשֶׁר גָּלְמִי שִׁפֵּר. קָצַב לוֹ בַּסֵּפֶר. בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר לִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: He remembers what was read out from the book that was bestowed by Him upon the first man even before its completion. He had decided in that book that He was to be remembered in every generation.

rows.he: קֶֽצֶב אִם הֶחֱרַט בַּסֵּֽפֶר. לְבִלְתִּי מְצוֹא כֹּֽפֶר. קִיּוּם זִכְרוֹן זֶה סֵֽפֶר. לְפָנָיו יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: When anger is written down in the book and no atonement can be found, then He remembers the confirmation of this book.

rows.he: זֵֽכֶר צָפוּן מֹרְדֵי אוֹר. תָּמִים דּוֹר כָּאוֹר. צִיָּה כְּחָר לָאוֹר. קְנוּיָו יִזְכֹּר:
rows.en: He remembers the hidden one (Noah) in the age of open rebels, the perfect and the pure; when He is angry and wishes to curse the earth, He remembers those acquired by Him (Israel).

rows.he: צְפוּפִים פְּנֵי נָאוֹר. מִשְׁפָּטָם תֵּת לָאוֹר. צַחַן רוֹעַ שְׂאוֹר. בְּרִיב בַּל יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: As to those who stand crowded together before the countenance of the Awe-inspiring, may He bring to light their judgment; may He not in strife recall the ugly evil leaven.

rows.he: זֵֽכֶר פְּעֻלַּת אֶזְרָח. הֵעַרְתָּהּ מִמִּזְרָח. פָּעֳלוֹ יִזְרָח. בְּקֶֽרֶב שָׁנִים יִזְכֹּר:
rows.en: He remembers the work of that strong one whom He told to rise up from the east (Abraham). May He soon recall his shining act.

rows.he: פַּח אִם הֻטְרַח. פִּרְחָיו לְמָרַח. פִּלּוּלוֹ יִצְרַח. בַּעֲדָם יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: When destruction threatens to annihilate his offspring, may his supplication become audible that He may remember them kindly.

rows.he: זֵֽכֶר עֲקֵדַת מוֹרִיָּה. כְּהִיַּת רְאִיָּה. עֲדֵי עֵרוֹם וְעֶרְיָה. סְבוּכוֹ יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: He remembers the sacrifice on Moriah (Isaac) whose eyes become dim; for the sake of people naked and bare, may He recall the ram caught in the thicket.

rows.he: עֵֽצֶב טְרִיָּה. אִם כּוֹאֲבָה פּוֹרִיָּה. עֲתָרוֹ לִרְאִיָּה. וְלִזְכוּת יִזְכֹּר:
rows.en: When the fruitful people is afflicted with a festering wound, may his prayer be manifest that God may remember his merit.

rows.he: זֵֽכֶר סֻלָּם חָלָם. וְעָלָיו מְחוֹלְלָם. שָׂרֵי אַרְבַּע וְעֻלָּם. כּוֹ כְּמֵאָז יִזְכֹּר:
rows.en: He remembers him who saw the ladder in the dream (Jacob); above it the Creator appeared to him, showed him the princes of the four empires and their yoke. He will remember him, as in former days.

rows.he: שְׂרִיגָיו בְּמַעֲלָם. וַיֹּאמַר לְגָעֳלָם. שִׂיחוֹ יוֹעִילָם. בְּרִית לִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: When His adherents are faithless and the Lord intends to reject them, may his prayer avail them that on their behalf the covenant may be remembered.

rows.he: זֵכֶר נְקוּבֵי מַטּוֹת. שְׁבוּעוֹת מַטּוֹת. נְדִידוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת. לְאַמְּצָם יִזְכֹּר:
rows.en: He remembers the noble tribes (twelve), the oath of the tribes, the wanderings of the tribes does He recall, to strengthen them.

rows.he: נֹשְׂאֵי עֹל מוֹטַת. אִם פָּץ לְהַמְטוֹת. נֶפֶץ חֲדַר הַמִּטּוֹת. לְכִפּוּר יִזְכֹּר:
rows.en: When He says that He will crush those who bear the heavy yoke, then He remembers as an atonement the destruction of the site of the Sanctuary.

rows.he: זֵכֶר מְצוּקִים. יְסוֹד מוּצָקִים. מִפְעָלָם לְצַעֲקִים. בְּפוּט חָשׁ לִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: He remembers the foundation stones (forefathers), who groan in Egyptian slavery.

rows.he: מִפִּי יוֹנְקִים. אֲשֶׁר בַּסּוּף נֶאֱקִים. מַאֲמַר בְּרִית וְחֻקִּים. דְּבַר קָדְשׁוֹ יִזְכֹּר:
rows.en: The sucklings who praised the Lord at the Sea of Reeds, the promise of the covenant (the circumcision) and the statutes (of the Torah), His holy word, all these does He remember.

rows.he: זֵכֶר לִין כְּפָרִים. וְאִמְרֵי שְׁפָרִים. לִמְשַׁלְּמֵי פָרִים. בְּשָׂפָה יִזְכֹּר:
rows.en: The memory of those who live austerely (students of the Torah) and study His beautiful sayings, who with their lips provide a substitute for sacrificial bullocks, He does remember.

rows.he: לְעֵת בִּקּוּר סְפָרִים. סְתָרִים מְסַפְּרִים. לִשְׁנֵי עֳפָרִים. לְצֶדֶק יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: When the books that announce what is hidden, are examined, He remembers in love the wonderful pair of brothers.

rows.he: זֵכֶר כְּבוֹד מִשְׁכָּן. מְקוֹם דּוֹד שָׁכַן. כְּרוּבִים בּוֹ שִׁכֵּן. חֶסֶד נְעוּרִים יִזְכֹּר:
rows.en: He remembers the honour of the sanctuary, the place where He, the Beloved, did dwell, where He allowed the Cherubim to rest, the love of our youth He remembers.

rows.he: כִּיּוֹר עִם כַּן. וְנֹעַם קוֹל דּוּכָן. כַּבִּיר בְּיוֹם מוּכָן. לַנְּבוֹנִים יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: The basin on its frame, the delightful voice (of the Levites) on the Temple steps, the Almighty recalls them in favour of the discerning on the appointed day of judgment.

rows.he: זֵכֶר יְלִיד נוּן. וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי אוּרִי אֶפְנוּן. יִזָּכְרוּ בְּרִנּוּן. פִּלְאָם לִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: He remembers (Joshua) the son of Nun, and the illuminating words of him who comes from Yephuneh, (Caleb), may they be recalled in prayer so that their deeds should be remembered.

rows.he: יֶקֶשׁ בְּרַק הַשָּׁנוּן. אִם הָשְׁלַף לְתַאֲנוּן. יַקְשִׁיב תַּחֲנוּן. חֲנוּנָיו לִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: When the destructive gleaming sword is drawn for grief, may He hear and remember the supplications of those He has favoured.

rows.he: זֵכֶר טַעַם שֹׁפְטִים. וְאוֹת קְצִיר חִטִּים. טֶפֶשׁ שׁוֹטִים. יְחַתֵּל מִלִּזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: He remembers the noble judges and the sign given by Samuel at the time of the wheat harvest. He heals the folly of the simple, so that it is no longer remembered.

rows.he: טֹרַח אַרְבַּעַת שְׁפָטִים. אִם נֶעֶנְשׁוּ נִשְׁפָּטִים. טֶבַע מִשְׁפָּטִים. אֲשֶׁר שָׂם יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: When the destructive gleaming sword is drawn for the four punishments, may He remember the nature of the judgments He gave them.

rows.he: זֵכֶר חֲצוֹת לַיְלָה. וְתוֹדוֹת מִשְׁפְּטֵי לַיְלָה. חֹשֶׁךְ בְּאִישׁוֹן לַיְלָה. נִגּוּנוֹ לָמוֹ יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: May He remember the hymns of praise in which David, at midnight, praised the rules of the night, may He remember his song in the darkness of the night on their behalf.

rows.he: חֵקֶר מִפְקַד לַיְלָה. יַגִּיהַּ בְּלַהַב לַיְלָה. חֹק הֶגֶה יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה. לְגִיהָם יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: May He illuminate the nightly search by the fire of the night upon the altar; the law in which they study by day and by night, may He remember for their healing.

rows.he: זֵכֶר זֶה זְבוּל. אֲשֶׁר בְּבִצְעִי חָבוּל. זְדוֹנוֹת סָבוּל. עוֹד בַּל יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: He remembers the palace that was taken from me on account of my selfishness. May He no longer recall that it was laden with deliberate sins.

rows.he: זַעַם כַּמַּבּוּל. אִם יָצְאָה לְחַבּוּל. זִכְרֹן יֶרַח בּוּל. לְחֶמְלָה יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: When anger, as at the time of the flood, is aroused in destruction, let Him remember the month of Bul (the completion of the Temple) in compassion.

rows.he: זֵכֶר וְכַח כָּל פֹּעַל. בְּקַו וָפֶלֶס יַעַל. וְאִם בְּמֶרֶד וְאִם בְּמַעַל. רַב חֶסֶד יִזְכֹּר:
rows.en: He re-members the test of every creature according to measure and in the scales; when they have committed acts of rebellion and faithlessness, may He remember them, full of compassion.

rows.he: וְאִם טוֹב וְאִם רַע. אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ יֵאָרַע. וֶסְתּוֹ יִפָּרַע. בְּסַאסְּאָה מִלִּזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: As to the good and the evil whose deeds and way of life should be requited, may He not remember them according to the severity of the law.

rows.he: זֵכֶר הַחַיִּים. עַד כַּמֶּה הֵם חַיִּים. הֵן לַמָּוֶת אִם לַחַיִּים. חַי חַי יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: He remembers life, how long their life shall be; for death or for life He remembers all the living.

rows.he: הֲמוֹן שְׁאוֹן בְּרוּאִים. יַעַבְרוּ לְפָנָיו כִּמְרִיאִים. הֲלֹא כְּמוֹ רְאוּיִים. לְכָל אֶחָד יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: The noisy throng of creatures passes before Him like lambs; He remembers each according to his worth.

rows.he: זֵכֶר דַּלּוּת וָעֹשֶׁר. בַּצֹּרֶת וָחֹשֶׁר. דּוֹפִי וְגַם יֹשֶׁר. בַּדִּין הוּא יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: He remembers poverty and wealth, need and plenty, vice and virtue; in judgment does He remember.

rows.he: דְּבַר גָּלוּי וָסֵתֶר. בִּנְיָנוֹת וְסוֹתֵר. דֵּי חָסֵר וָיֶתֶר. לְקֶצֶב יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: The open and the hidden, building and tearing down, death and superfluity, does He measure and remember.

rows.he: זֵכֶר גְּנוּנִים לְיַשֵּׁב. בַּמִּדְבָּר וְיוֹשֵׁב. גֶּשֶׁם וְרוּחַ לְנַשֵּׁב. מֵהַיּוֹם יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: He remembers those who should live sheltered in the wilderness or in settlements; to send rain and wind does He remember.

rows.he: גָּרוֹן לְהַקְשֵׁב. מֵעַם שְׁמוֹ חוֹשֵׁב. גָּלְיוֹת לְהָשֵׁב. בְּיוֹם תֶּקַע יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: To hear the prayer of the people that reveres His Name and to lead back the exiles does He remember on the day of the Tekiah.

rows.he: זֵכֶר בַּהַל וְחֵמָה. קְרָב וּמִלְחָמָה. בִּקּוּעַ חוֹמָה. לְחוֹמַת יָם יִזְכֹּר:
rows.en: He recalls terror and wrath, battle and wars; the destruction of the wall (Jerusalem) He remembers against the wall of the sea.

rows.he: בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה. אִם הָקְנַס מְהוּמָה. בְּצוּר קוֹל הוֹמָה. לָאֲדָמָה יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: When confusion has been decreed as punishment for man and beast, He remembers the loud entreaty of the earth.

rows.he: זֵכֶר אֱמוּנָה וָשֶׁקֶר. אוֹזֶן שִׂיחַ וָסֶקֶר. אוֹת פְּקֻדַּת בֹּקֶר. לִרְגָעִים יִזְכּוֹר:
rows.en: He remembers fidelity and falsehood by ear, speech and glance, the test of every morning and every moment does He recall.

rows.he: אִם לְזוֹל אִם לִיקָר. אוֹ לָטַעַת אוֹ לְעַקֵּר. אֱנוֹשׁ בְּדִקְדּוּק וָחֵקֶר. לַמִּשְׁפָּט יִזְכֹּר:
rows.en: He remembers abundance or scarcity, planting or uprooting, for mankind with care and searching in judgment.

The hyphen is a line-wrap hyphen and the word reads 'He remembers'. This is one word, not a missing passage. Dehyphenating it is an encoding decision and is not done here.

Row 28: the English repeats 'the destructive gleaming sword is drawn', which corresponds to row 26 (יֶקֶשׁ בְּרַק הַשָּׁנוּן), not to טֹרַח. This is an anomaly in the translation itself. It is aligned as printed and not treated as a missing translation.

Row 19: the English renders only part of 'מִפְעָלָם לְצַעֲקִים. בְּפוּט חָשׁ לִזְכּוֹר' ('who groan in Egyptian slavery'). The translation is free, but the scope is complete.

Rows 15–16: שׂ (sin) stands for the samekh slot (שָׂרֵי / שְׂרִיגָיו). The acrostic is consistent.

rows.he: אֶפְחַד בְּמַעֲשַׂי. אֶדְאַג בְּכָל עֵת. אִירָא בְּיוֹם דִּין. בְּבוֹאִי לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: I am anxious because of my deeds, I worry constantly, I fear on the day of judgment, when I come for remembrance.

rows.he: אֶדְרוֹשׁ לְחַנּוּן. אֲחַלֶּה לְרַחוּם. אֲחַנֵּן לְחַק לִי. יוֹם לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: I seek out the Merciful, I entreat the Compassionate, I implore Him who has appointed this day for me for remembrance.

rows.he: בְּבוֹאִי לְמִשְׁפָּט. בְּמִי אֶשָּׁעֵן. וּמִי יְחַפֶּשׂ לִי. צֶֽדֶק לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: When I come in judgment, on whom shall I rely, who will find righteousness for me as a remembrance?

rows.he: בָּאָבוֹת בָּטַֽחְתִּי. וּפָעֳלָם אָכַֽלְתִּי. וְהֵם הָיוּ לִי. קֶֽדֶם לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: Upon the fathers I put my trust, I derive benefit from their work, they have from of old served as my remembrance.

rows.he: גָּבְרָה זְרוֹעִי. כְּשָׂח מְחֵנִי נָא. לְבַל יִמַּח מֶנִּי. שֵׁם וְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: My arm was strong when Moses pleaded to be wiped out, so that my name should not be wiped out nor should my remembrance.

rows.he: גֶּֽבֶר אִם יַעֲמוֹד לְפָנָיו הֲיוֹעִיל. בְּעֵת יְבֻקַּשׁ מֶנִּי. זְכוּת לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: Should a man stand before the Lord, can he then help me, when merit is required from me for remembrance.

rows.he: דַּצְתִּי בְּלוֹבֵשׁ אֵפוֹד. וְחֹֽשֶׁן הַמִּשְׁפָּט. אֲשֶׁר בָּם הוּחַק. שְׁמִי לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: I rejoiced with him (Aaron) who wore the Ephod and the Breast-plate of Judgment on which my name was engraved for remembrance.

rows.he: דִּלֵּג בְּמַחְתָּה. עַד יֵעָצֵר נֶֽגֶף. בְּגֶֽשֶׁת זָר מְכַהֵן. יָקוּד לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: He hastened with his censor until the plague had abated, when a stranger (Korah) approached to act as priest, the flames devoured him as a remembrance.

rows.he: הַבִּֽיטָה אֵל. בְּעָמְדִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ. אֵין בְּקִרְבִּי אֱנוֹשׁ. תָּוִי לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: Behold, O God, when I stand before Thee, there is no man in my midst whom I could designate for remembrance.

rows.he: הֲיֵשׁ מִי יְפַלֵּל. וְיָשִׁיב חֵמָה. וְיוּחַק לַדּוֹרֹת. שְׁמוֹ לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: Can anyone pray and turn back anger (like Pinhas),then let his name be inscribed for future generations as a remembrance.

rows.he: וּמִי שׂוֹנֵא בֶֽצַע. יְדַבֵּר עֲנוּ בִי. וַיַּעַן וַיֹּאמַר עֵד. אָדוֹן לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: Who is it that hates gain that he might say: “Testify against me”, and the Lord Himself replied as a witness for remembrance.

rows.he: וּבְטָלֵה חָלָב. יְכַפֵּר בַּעֲדֵנוּ. וּכְנֶֽגֶד שְׁנֵי עֳפָרִים. יַעַל לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: With a sucking lamb he (Samuel) atoned for us and, equal to the noble pair of brothers (Moses and Aaron), he rises for remembrance.

rows.he: זַֽעַף יֵרָא וַיֹּאמַר. תְּהִי יָדְךָ בִי. אֲשֶׁר כְּלֵב אֱלֹהָיו. הוּא לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: When he saw the wrath of the Lord, he (David) said: “Let Thy hand turn against me”, that he conformed to the will of his God is his remembrance.

rows.he: זָעַק וְהֵשִׁיב. חֶֽרֶב אֶל נְדָנָהּ. וְהוּשַׁת לוֹ כַּשֶּֽׁמֶשׁ. כֵּס לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: He cried out and caused the angel’s sword to return to its sheath, therefore was his throne established as firmly as the sun for remembrance.

rows.he: חִכֵּיתִי בְּעֵת עֹֽצֶר. לְפוֹתֵחַ וּמַמְטִיר. כְּמֵשִׁיב רוּחַ לַיֶּֽלֶד. אָבוּד מִזִּכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: At the time of drought I wait for Him who releases and brings rain (Elijah), who restored breath to the child already lost to remembrance.

rows.he: חַי לִרְאוֹת בְּרִית. בְּדַבְּרוֹ קִנֵּאתִי. כִּי עָזְבוּ עָם. בְּרִית וְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: He lives on as a witness at circumcisions because he spoke of his zeal when the people had abandoned both covenant and remembrance.

rows.he: טֶֽרֶם הָיָה לִי. מְכַפֵּר פָּנִים. מִנְחָה הֹלֶֽכֶת. כַּשֹּׁחַד לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: Formerly I had one who could atone before the Lord, when he brought the meal-offering as a bribe for remembrance.

rows.he: טֶֽרֶף נֵרְדְּ וְסַמִּים. לְמֵסַב חֲדָרָיו. דָּם וָחֵֽלֶב לְנִיחֹחַ. וְלֶֽחֶם הַפָּנִים לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: Gifts of nard and spices perfumed His chambers, blood and fat as a delight and the show-bread for remembrance.

rows.he: יֻצַּֽגְתִּי עַל גֶּחָלֵי רֵיקָה. כִּי לֹא אַלְמָן. שַׁתִּי לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: I was placed like an empty vessel upon the coals, that Israel may not be widowed, I plead for remembrance.

rows.he: יָהּ אֶבְטַח בָּךְ. וְלֹא בִּנְדִיבִים. כִּי הֵם בַּקֶּבֶר. וְלָנֶצַח שִׁמְךָ לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: O Lord, in Thee do I trust and not in princes, for they are in the grave and Thy Name is for ever for remembrance.

rows.he: כָּל אֵלֶּה סְמָכוּנִי. וְרַחֲמֶיךָ בִּקַּשְׁתִּי. לוּלֵא הֵם תַּמֹּתִי. וְאֵינִי לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: All these supported me but I seek Thy compassion, without it I should have perished and not survived for remembrance.

rows.he: כִּי הֵם בִּזְרוֹעַ. עָדֶיךָ לֹא בָאוּ. רוֹמְמוּתֶיךָ בְּפִיהֶם. שָׂמוּ לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: For in spite of their strength, they could not plead for me before Thee, those in whose mouths is Thy greatness have placed it there for remembrance.

rows.he: לְיוֹם זֶה נִכְמָס. סֶכֶם חֶשְׁבּוֹנוֹת. תְּחִלָּה לְיָמִים. וְרֹאשׁ לְזִכָּרֹן:
rows.en: For this day has been stored the sum of assessments, it is the beginning of days and the first for remembrance.

rows.he: לְהִקָּרֵא בוֹ. כְּתַב עֵט וְשָׁמִיר. גָּלוּי וּבָאֵר. וְיָדוּעַ לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: On it there is read out what was engraved with a diamond quill, what was revealed and explained and known in remembrance.

rows.he: מָוֶת וְחַיִּים. שָׁלוֹם וּמִלְחָמוֹת. צַחֲצָחוֹת וָשׂוֹבַע. בָּאִים לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: Death and life, peace and war, dearth and abundance, appear for remembrance.

rows.he: מַעַלְלֵי גֶבֶר. וּמִסְפַּר צְעָדָיו. נִשְׁכְּחוּ מֵאֱנוֹשׁ. וְלָאֵל לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: The acts of man, the number of his steps, though forgotten by men, they are to God for remembrance.

rows.he: נִסְתְּרָה דַרְכִּי. מִי יוּכַל שִׂיחַ. לַשָּׁוְא נִכְתַּב לִי. חֵטְא לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: “My way is hidden” — who could say that? In vain was a sin inscribed for me for remembrance.

rows.he: נֶגֶד פְּנֵי גֶבֶר. מַעֲשָׂיו יוֹכִיחוּ. וְיַעֲנֶה בּוֹ כַּחֲשׁוֹ. עֵד לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: In front of man his deeds give evidence, his falsehood bears witness against him for remembrance.

rows.he: שִׂיחוּ מְזִמּוֹת אֵל. יַחַד כָּל בְּנֵי אִישׁ. עוֹבְרֵי תַּחַת שֵׁבֶט. כַּצֹּאן לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: Proclaim the plans of the Lord, all men together, pass under the staff like a flock for remembrance.

rows.he: סוֹגֵר דֶּלֶת. בְּעַד תְּמִימִים בְּזַעַם. עַד בֹּא קִצָּם. צֵאת לְזִכָּרוֹן:
rows.en: The Lord closes the door on behalf of the flawless during the storm until their destiny arrives and they go forth for remembrance.
